arguments.code:
song_ids_list=[37,38,39,40,41,42,43]
tracks=[]
for sid in song_ids_list:
    s=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    print('sid',sid,'title',s.get('title'),'play_count',s.get('play_count'))
    tracks.append(s)
# find most listened by play_count
max_track=max(tracks, key=lambda x: x.get('play_count',0))
print('max_track', max_track.get('song_id'), max_track.get('title'), max_track.get('play_count'))
# play it
play_resp=apis.spotify.play_music(access_token=token, song_id=max_track.get('song_id'))
print('play_resp', play_resp)
